briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies ahead of Q4 benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has accelerated with multiple frontier labs releasing iterative models. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate discussions amid record funding.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion shows gains in multi-agent reasoning while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus leads in safety evals. DeepSeek R2 and Meta's Llama 4 challenge US dominance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units monthly. Microsoft and xAI expand Memphis and Phoenix clusters with new HBM4 deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory caps on training runs above 10^27 FLOPs slow the US lead or accelerate offshore development?
